The '''Geothermal Substation''' was a substation of the [[Tromper Crags Geothermal Plant]], a large geothermal powerplant constructed by [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] colonists in [[Highmount Ridge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The substation was located southwest of the actual plant, at the intersection of [[Highmount Road]] and the [[Lower Pass]].
